evidence: Matches the P2P label and modifies AddrMan logic in src/addrman.cpp.
rationale: Fixes a logic bug where AddrMan compares raw incoming timestamps against penalized stored timestamps, causing identical announcements relayed across multiple peers to artificially inflate multiplicity in the new table up to 8. As noted by the author, this is a minor bug fix rather than an adversarial protection since peers can trivially alter timestamps to achieve the same effect.
